Name: The Grove Farm
Author: ETSGreen
Description:
A large and well decorated map that is designed to be well balanced for all professions except fishing, with two large patches for farmland, dedicated spots for fruit trees, a dense forest area with respawning stumps and enough open land for animal pens.

The paths to robin's and the town are close to the main house, but the farmland and the path to Marnie is further away to balance this out.


This mod just adds a new farm map that you can use instead of the vanilla choices. It should be compatible with any other mod.
If you happen to stumble across a rare incompatibility, let me know and I will list it here.

[b][u]IMPORTANT:

[/u][/b]For multiplayer this map only supports up to 3 additional cabins at game start, and only when using the "nearby" cabin placement. If you choose separate" it WILL NOT spawn the extra cabins!

Downloads.Description: For stardew 1.6, uses Custom Farm Loader
